Class OrderManager

java.lang.Object
boba.shop.model.OrderManager
public class OrderManager extends Object
Manages the state of the current customer order using the Singleton pattern. This class holds the list of items being ordered, calculates the total price, and handles the submission of the order to the database.

    • submitOrder

      public boolean submitOrder(String paymentMethod)
      Submits the current order to the database. This method aggregates item counts and customizations into JSON strings, creates an Order object, and inserts it using OrderDAO.
      Parameters:
      paymentMethod - The payment method used (e.g., "cash", "card").
      Returns:
      true if the order was successfully inserted, false otherwise.
